2.title: Create a note from a transcript selection
2.preconditions: A track is playing and its transcript is open.

steps.action: Touch-and-drag across a sentence in the transcript to select text.
steps.expected: The selection popover opens anchored to the selection with actions: Copy, Bookmark, Share, Ask.

steps.action: Tap Bookmark.
steps.expected: The note is saved; the popover closes.

steps.action: Observe the transcript and open the Notes tab.
steps.expected: The selected sentence is now underlined in the transcript, and the new note appears at the top of the Notes list.

3.title: Notes list shows note text and track metadata

steps.action: Open the Notes tab.
steps.expected: Each note row shows the saved text, the track title and author, the date/location if available, and the fragment duration. Notes are sorted most-recent first.

4.title: Search notes by text with highlight
4.preconditions: Several notes exist, at least one containing the word used below.

steps.action: In the Notes tab, type a query of 4+ characters into the search field.
steps.expected: The list filters in real time to notes containing the query (case-insensitive); matching whole words are highlighted.

steps.action: Clear the search field.
steps.expected: The full notes list is shown again.

5.title: Delete a note from the Notes list

steps.action: Tap a note in the list.
steps.expected: An action sheet opens with Copy, Share, Delete, Cancel.

steps.action: Tap Delete.
steps.expected: The note is removed from the list immediately and does not reappear after leaving and returning to the tab.

6.title: Delete a note from the transcript underline
6.preconditions: A track is playing, its transcript is open, and it contains a saved note (underlined).

steps.action: Tap the underlined note span in the transcript.
steps.expected: The selection popover opens in existing-note mode showing Copy, Share, Ask, Delete (Bookmark hidden).

steps.action: Tap Delete.
steps.expected: The underline is removed immediately, the popover closes, and the note disappears from the Notes tab.

steps.action: Tap a note, then Share, then Share Text.
steps.expected: The system share sheet opens with the note text formatted together with the track author, title, reference and date.

8.title: Share a note as an audio excerpt
8.preconditions: At least one note exists on a track with available audio.

steps.action: Tap a note, then Share, then Share Audio.
steps.expected: A 'Preparing audio' spinner appears while the excerpt (note start→end) is cut.

steps.action: Wait for the excerpt to be ready.
steps.expected: If ready within ~3s the share sheet opens with the audio file; otherwise a background job continues and a toast indicates sharing will continue in the background, then the share sheet opens when ready.

9.title: Empty notes state
9.preconditions: No notes have been created (fresh install or all deleted).

steps.action: Open the Notes tab.
steps.expected: An empty-state sticker is shown with an illustration, a 'no notes' heading, guidance to create notes by selecting transcript text, and a button that navigates to Search.

steps.action: Note the existing notes, then fully close and relaunch the app.
steps.expected: All previously created notes are still present in the Notes tab with the same text and metadata.

11.title: Open a note in Studio is Pro-gated
11.preconditions: A note exists in the Notes list.

steps.action: Tap a note → Share → "Share video" (the Pro-badged Studio entry point; there is no item literally labelled "Open in Studio").
steps.expected: If not subscribed, the paywall (subscription screen) opens. If subscribed, the Studio editor opens with the note's track/segment.

12.title: Activity widget appears after first track, hidden on fresh install
12.preconditions: Two states to verify: (a) a brand-new install with no tracks; (b) after at least one track was added/played.

steps.action: Open Home on a fresh install with an empty playlist.
steps.expected: The activity widget (heatmap, streak, completed count, total listened) is hidden.

steps.action: Add a track to the playlist and play part of it, then return to Home.
steps.expected: The activity widget is now shown with streak and completion badges.

13.title: Empty Home offers featured starter packs

steps.action: Open Home with an empty playlist.
steps.expected: Featured collections are shown as starter packs to populate the queue.

steps.action: Tap a starter-pack collection card.
steps.expected: All tracks from that collection are added to the playlist in one batch and Home updates to show them.

14.title: Notifications nag takes precedence over subscription nag
14.preconditions: User has tracks in the playlist, notifications permission NOT granted, not subscribed, past the 7-day install grace.

steps.action: Open Home.
steps.expected: Only one nag banner shows at a time, and it is the notifications nag (it wins over the subscription nag).

steps.action: Dismiss the notifications nag and reopen Home within the cooldown window.
steps.expected: The notifications nag does not reappear during its 14-day cooldown; the subscription nag may appear instead.

15.title: Consecutive tracks from one collection render as a group
15.preconditions: Playlist contains 2+ consecutive tracks added via 'add all' from the same collection.

steps.action: Open Home.
steps.expected: The consecutive same-collection rows fold into a group with a collection header (title + dominant author + collection background).

steps.action: Inspect a single track added from a collection (not via add-all).
steps.expected: It renders as a standalone row, not grouped.

16.title: Tapping a Home row opens the player at the saved position
16.preconditions: A playlist track has saved progress (>0).

steps.action: Tap a track row on Home that has prior progress.
steps.expected: The player opens and resumes from the saved position, not from the start.

17.title: Up-next queue shows count and total duration

steps.action: Open Home and view the Up Next section.
steps.expected: Playlist items are listed in order with a queue-count badge and a total-duration badge.

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of a long queue.
steps.expected: More items load via infinite scroll.

18.title: Swipe-to-archive removes a track but keeps its completion badge
18.preconditions: Playlist has at least one track; one of them was listened to completion earlier (shows the completed double-check).

steps.action: Swipe the completed queue row and confirm the delete/archive action.
steps.expected: The row is removed from the active queue (Home playlist).

steps.action: Find the same (previously completed) track in Search / Library.
steps.expected: It still shows the completed double-check badge; its downloaded file is untouched, and it can be re-added.

steps.action: Re-add that completed + archived track to the playlist and open the Home playlist.
steps.expected: The queue row appears as a FRESH item: empty / 0% progress (state "added"). It must NOT show the completed double-check and must NOT show a 100% radial — playlist progress is the current pass since the last add.

steps.action: Re-open Search / Library (and the player) for that same track.
steps.expected: The completed double-check badge is STILL shown there. Lifetime completion persists across archive + re-add and is independent of the fresh playlist progress.

19.title: Completed track shows a persistent double-check
19.preconditions: A track has been listened to completion.

steps.action: View a completed track in the playlist and in Search/Library.
steps.expected: It shows the completed double-check indicator in every surface, and the badge persists even after the track is archived.

steps.action: Re-add the same track after it was completed and archived.
steps.expected: It comes back as a fresh entry starting from 0 — the old completed position is NOT resumed (progress resets on re-add).

20.title: Search list is populated on open

steps.action: Open the Search page with no query.
steps.expected: The full catalog is shown, paginated (about 50 per page), list is not empty.

21.title: Infinite scroll loads the next page and stops at the end
21.preconditions: A query/filter set that returns more than one page.

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of the results.
steps.expected: The next page of tracks loads automatically.

steps.action: Continue scrolling until the last page.
steps.expected: No further requests fire once all results are loaded (no duplicate/endless loading).

22.title: Filter tracks by title
22.preconditions: Catalog contains tracks whose title includes the query term.

steps.action: Type a title term (e.g. 'Krishna') into the search input.
steps.expected: After a short debounce, the list updates to tracks whose title matches the term; only one search runs at a time.

23.title: Verse-reference search matches the exact reference (no prefix bleed)
23.preconditions: Catalog has tracks referencing both 'bg 1.1' and 'bg 1.11'.

steps.action: Enter 'bg 1.1' into the search input.
steps.expected: Results contain tracks for verse BG 1.1 and do NOT bleed into BG 1.10 / 1.11 — a dotted reference matches the exact verse (adjacency phrase), not a prefix. (A bare number like a year IS a prefix match.)

steps.action: Enter a query that matches nothing (e.g. 'zzzznotexist').
steps.expected: A centered empty state appears (icon + 'no results' + a hint to check filters); the list is empty and no error is shown.

steps.action: Open the filters sheet.
steps.expected: Multi-select sections are shown: Languages, Authors, Locations, Sources, Tags, Topics, plus Date range, Duration and Sort.

26.title: Applying an author filter narrows results and shows a count badge
26.preconditions: Catalog has tracks by the chosen author.

steps.action: Select one author in the Authors section.
steps.expected: The search re-runs immediately, results show only that author's tracks, pagination resets, and the filters button shows an active-filter count badge.

steps.action: Select a second author.
steps.expected: Results expand to include both authors and the badge count increments.

27.title: Reset clears all filters
27.preconditions: One or more filters are applied.

steps.action: Tap Reset in the filters sheet.
steps.expected: All selections are cleared and the search re-runs against the full catalog; the active-filter badge disappears.

28.title: Language filter scopes the catalog
28.preconditions: Catalog contains tracks in more than one content language.

steps.action: Select a single content language in the Languages section.
steps.expected: Only tracks in that language are shown; the lecture count reflects the filtered set.

steps.action: Keep the language selected and add a second facet (e.g. a tag or topic) that has no overlap with that language, so the combined filter matches zero tracks.
steps.expected: The list is empty and the empty-state hint is shown (no crash). Clearing/resetting the filters immediately re-queries and restores results.

29.title: Track row goes from none to added
29.preconditions: A track not in the playlist (state none).

steps.action: Tap the track row, then 'Add to playlist' in the track sheet.
steps.expected: The row shows the added checkmark and the track appears in the Home playlist.

steps.action: Re-open the track sheet for the same track.
steps.expected: The 'Add to playlist' button is disabled and its label reads 'Already in playlist' (no re-add, no silent no-op).

30.title: Download progress shows a radial indicator

steps.action: Trigger a download for the track.
steps.expected: The row shows a radial progress ring updating 0–100% while downloading.

steps.action: Wait for completion.
steps.expected: The row transitions to added/completed; the audio is available offline.

31.title: Failed download shows red X and retries from the track sheet
31.preconditions: A track whose download can be made to fail (e.g. no network during download).

steps.action: Cause a download to fail and observe the row.
steps.expected: The row shows a red X (failed) state.

steps.action: Tap the failed row.
steps.expected: The track sheet opens (tap always opens the sheet) and its primary button reads 'Download again'.

steps.action: Tap 'Download again'.
steps.expected: The download retries; on success the row becomes added/completed.

32.title: Discovery surfaces fold playback progress to a binary state
32.preconditions: A track that is currently playing or queued with saved progress.

steps.action: View the playing/queued track in Search or Library.
steps.expected: The row shows a single checkmark (added) — no progress radial; the progress radial appears only on the Home queue.

33.title: Add multiple tracks
33.preconditions: On a list with several addable tracks.

steps.action: Add several tracks one after another.
steps.expected: Each is added and appears in the Home queue in the order added; row states update to added.

steps.action: Open the Library (Search tab landing).
steps.expected: The library landing page loads without errors.

steps.action: Observe the collection-group carousels.
steps.expected: Collection-group carousels are shown.

steps.action: Observe the topics grid.
steps.expected: A topics grid is shown.

steps.action: Observe the Full Library banner.
steps.expected: A Full Library banner is shown with a lecture count.

steps.action: Observe the topic shelves.
steps.expected: Topic shelves (lectures grouped by topic) are shown.

steps.action: Observe the Smart Library banner.
steps.expected: A Smart Library banner is shown.

steps.action: Observe the all-lectures preview.
steps.expected: An all-lectures preview is shown.

35.title: Library content is scoped to selected library languages
35.preconditions: Library content language set to a single language.

steps.action: Note the lecture count and visible collections/topics for the current library language.
steps.expected: Only tracks in the selected language are shown; the Full Library count reflects that language; topics with zero tracks in it do not appear.

steps.action: Switch the library content language to another language.
steps.expected: Content reloads in place (old content stays visible during load, new fades in, no full-page spinner); counts and lists update to the new language.

36.title: Library language is independent from UI language
36.preconditions: UI language and library language set to different languages.

steps.action: Observe UI labels vs track/collection titles.
steps.expected: UI chrome follows the app language while track and collection titles follow the library content language.

steps.action: Change the app (UI) language only.
steps.expected: UI labels switch; track/collection titles stay in the library language (unchanged).

38.title: Open a collection and view its contents

steps.action: Tap a collection card (from a carousel, the Other Collections list, or See All Collections).
steps.expected: The collection detail page opens with a hero cover, title, optional description, an Add All button, and the track list scoped to the library language.

39.title: Add a single track from a collection
39.preconditions: A collection is open with at least one track not yet in the playlist.

steps.action: Tap a track row in the collection to open its track sheet, then tap "Add to playlist".
steps.expected: The track is added (its row state flips to "added") and the sheet closes. No confirmation toast is shown for a single add.

40.title: Add the whole collection at once

steps.action: Tap "Add all" in the collection toolbar.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog asks to add N lectures (N = the language-filtered track count of the collection).

steps.action: Confirm the dialog.
steps.expected: All N language-filtered tracks are added to the playlist with collection provenance. No success toast is shown (an error toast appears only on failure).

41.title: Collection contents respect the library language
41.preconditions: A collection with tracks in more than one language; one library language selected.

steps.action: Open the collection.
steps.expected: Only tracks in the selected library language are listed; the count reflects the filtered set; Add All adds only those.

steps.action: Open a collection that has zero tracks in the selected language.
steps.expected: The list is empty, Add All is disabled, and no error state is shown.

43.title: Open a topic from the grid
43.preconditions: Library landing is loaded with a topics grid.

steps.action: Tap a topic tile in the grid.
steps.expected: The topic detail page opens with a hero cover (parallax on scroll), the topic name, and the top tracks for that topic scoped to the library language.

44.title: Open a topic from a shelf
44.preconditions: Library landing shows personalized topic shelves.

steps.action: Tap 'See all' on a topic shelf.
steps.expected: The same topic detail page opens with the full track list for that topic.

45.title: Topic page respects the library language
45.preconditions: A topic with tracks in multiple languages; one library language selected.

steps.action: Open the topic.
steps.expected: Only tracks in the selected language appear; the count reflects the filtered membership.

steps.action: Open a topic with no tracks in the selected language.
steps.expected: An empty/short list is shown with no error.

46.title: Add tracks from a topic
46.preconditions: A topic detail page is open.

steps.action: Tap a track to open its sheet and add it.
steps.expected: The track is added to the playlist.

47.title: Smart Library banner shows PRO badge and opens paywall when not subscribed
47.preconditions: Not subscribed; IAP available in this build.

steps.action: View the Library landing and locate the Smart Library banner.
steps.expected: The banner shows a PRO badge.

steps.action: Tap the banner.
steps.expected: The paywall opens (Smart Library feature).

48.title: Smart Library banner is hidden when IAP is unavailable

steps.action: View the Library landing.
steps.expected: The Smart Library banner is not shown; no dead paywall is reachable.

49.title: Subscriber opens the Smart Library dialog

steps.action: Tap the Smart Library banner.
steps.expected: The Smart Library dialog opens with an Enable toggle, a Filters row, a download Target section (Off/30m/1h/2h/3h/5h/8h/10h), and an Auto-archive section (Off/Immediate/8h/1d/2d/3d).

steps.action: Toggle Enable ON.
steps.expected: Target, archive and filter controls become active and persist.

steps.action: Toggle Enable OFF.
steps.expected: Controls are disabled, the background loop stops, and the summary shows Off.

51.title: Configure Smart Library filters and target

steps.action: Open the Filters row and select a language and an author, then confirm.
steps.expected: A comma-separated filter summary is shown below the row; Reset clears it back to 'No filters'.

steps.action: Select a target of 2h and an auto-archive of 2 days.
steps.expected: The subtitle updates to reflect target + filters + archive delay, and the same configuration is reflected on the Settings Smart Library item.

52.title: Smart Library auto-download honors the target
52.preconditions: Pro; Smart Library enabled with filters and a target.

steps.action: Leave the app running with the target set above the currently downloaded duration.
steps.expected: Matching tracks are downloaded in the background until the total downloaded duration reaches the target, then downloading pauses.

steps.action: Listen to / archive some downloaded tracks so the total drops below target.
steps.expected: Auto-download resumes to top back up to the target; completed tracks auto-archive after the configured delay.

53.title: Floating mini-player pulses until the transcript is opened
53.preconditions: First-time user who has not yet opened a transcript.

steps.action: Play a track and observe the floating player.
steps.expected: The floating player appears and pulses (invite-click animation) on a loop.

steps.action: Tap the floating player to open the transcript, then return.
steps.expected: The pulse stops permanently once the transcript has been opened (it is not a 3-second one-shot).

54.title: Play / pause from the floating player
54.preconditions: A track is loaded in the player.

steps.action: Tap the play/pause button on the floating player.
steps.expected: Playback toggles immediately and the button state updates; position continues from where it paused.

steps.action: Tap skip-back.
steps.expected: Playback seeks back 15s (clamped at 0).

steps.action: Tap skip-forward.
steps.expected: Playback seeks forward 15s.

56.title: Change playback speed with snap to presets
56.preconditions: The player speed control is visible.

steps.action: Drag the speed slider and release between presets.
steps.expected: The puck snaps to the nearest preset (0.75–2.0x), a haptic tick fires, and the new rate applies to audio with pitch preserved.

steps.action: Restart the app.
steps.expected: The chosen playback speed persists.

57.title: Seek by tapping a transcript timestamp/chapter
57.preconditions: Transcript is open while a track plays.

steps.action: Tap a chapter/timestamp in the transcript.
steps.expected: Playback jumps to that position and the transcript highlight follows.

58.title: Floating player hides in overlapping contexts
58.preconditions: A track is playing (floating player visible).

steps.action: Open the keyboard (e.g. focus a search field), open an action sheet, and navigate to the Chat tab in turn.
steps.expected: The floating player is hidden in each of these contexts and reappears when the context is dismissed.

steps.action: As FREE, open Settings and try to enable Auto-play next.
steps.expected: The toggle is locked and tapping it opens the paywall (continuous playback).

steps.action: As PRO, enable Auto-play next and let a track finish.
steps.expected: The next queued track starts automatically and the floating player/transcript re-syncs to it.

60.title: Transcript synchronizes to playback position
60.preconditions: Transcript is open and the track is playing.

steps.action: Let playback advance.
steps.expected: The current sentence is highlighted as audio progresses; with auto-scroll enabled (Pro) the view scrolls to keep it in view.

61.title: Select transcript text with a touch drag to open the popover

steps.action: Touch and drag across words/sentences (a drag, not a tap).
steps.expected: On release, the selection popover opens anchored to the selection with Copy, Bookmark, Share, Ask.

62.title: Outline / chapters navigation
62.preconditions: Transcript open for a track that has chapters.

steps.action: View the outline section and tap a chapter.
steps.expected: Each chapter shows its timestamp range and title; tapping seeks playback to that chapter.

63.title: Switch transcript language
63.preconditions: Track has transcripts in more than one language.

steps.action: Open the language selector and switch language.
steps.expected: The transcript re-renders in the selected language; timestamps and chapter references carry over.

64.title: Transcript loading, error and empty states
64.preconditions: Ability to open transcripts that are loading, missing, or fail to fetch.

steps.action: Open a transcript while it is still fetching.
steps.expected: A loading state is shown until content arrives.

steps.action: Open a track that has no transcript / force a fetch failure.
steps.expected: An appropriate 'no text available' or error state is shown; the user can dismiss and return to playback without a crash.

65.title: Share a transcript as PDF
65.preconditions: A track with a transcript; Pro if share is gated in this build.

steps.action: From the track, choose Share, then the transcript/PDF option.
steps.expected: A warm CDN copy is used if present, otherwise the PDF is rendered; the file downloads locally and the native share sheet opens with the PDF.

67.title: Share an audio excerpt from a transcript selection

steps.action: Select text and choose Share in the popover.
steps.expected: The share sheet opens with the quote formatted with track author, title and timestamp.

68.title: Background share job when rendering is slow
68.preconditions: A share-audio action that takes longer than ~3 seconds.

steps.action: Trigger a share-audio that takes >3s to render.
steps.expected: A spinner shows for ~3s, then a toast indicates the job continues in the background; the share sheet opens automatically when the file is ready. A second concurrent share is prevented.

69.title: Stereo mixer blends left and right channels
69.preconditions: A track with two-channel (e.g. EN/RU) audio is playing; the mixer control is visible.

steps.action: Drag the mixer puck toward the left label.
steps.expected: The left channel is routed to both ears; dragging to center is native stereo (mix off); dragging right routes the right channel to both ears.

70.title: Center deadzone snaps back to off

steps.action: Drag the puck a little inside the center deadzone and release.
steps.expected: The puck visibly snaps back to center, the mix commits to 0 (off), and a single haptic tick fires.

71.title: Crossing the engagement boundary fires one haptic tick

steps.action: Drag past the deadzone boundary and back.
steps.expected: The mix engages/disengages at the boundary and exactly one light haptic tick fires per crossing.

72.title: Mix setting persists across tracks and restarts
72.preconditions: Mixer set to a non-center position.

steps.action: Set the mix to a non-center value, switch tracks, then restart the app.
steps.expected: The mix position is restored and re-applied automatically.

73.title: Mixer is a no-op on mono audio
73.preconditions: A track with only single-channel original audio.

steps.action: Open the mixer on a mono track and move the puck.
steps.expected: The puck responds visually but there is no audible change and no error (graceful degrade).

74.title: Download a track for offline playback
74.preconditions: A track not yet downloaded; network available.

steps.action: Trigger the download.
steps.expected: State goes idle→downloading with a 0–100% radial; the audio file transfers and the transcript is prefetched in the background.

steps.action: Wait for completion.
steps.expected: State becomes completed and the track is playable offline.

steps.action: Fully close and relaunch the app.
steps.expected: The track still shows as downloaded/completed (state hydrated from the local DB) and plays from cache.

76.title: Retry a failed download
76.preconditions: A track whose download failed (red X).

steps.action: Tap the failed download to retry.
steps.expected: Any stale partial file is deleted and a fresh transfer starts from the beginning; on success the row becomes completed.

77.title: Recover an interrupted download after force-close

steps.action: Force-close the app while a download is in flight, then relaunch.
steps.expected: The incomplete download is marked failed on launch and the download control is re-enabled so the user can retry (no permanently-stuck 'downloading').

78.title: CDN rotation on server failure
78.preconditions: Ability to make the active CDN fail mid-transfer.

steps.action: Cause the active server to fail during a download.
steps.expected: The download retries from the next candidate server and, on success, the working server is promoted for subsequent sessions.

steps.action: Tap download twice in quick succession (or navigate away and back).
steps.expected: Only one transfer runs; the second request joins the in-flight one (single radial), no parallel duplicate download.

80.title: Play a downloaded track with no network
80.preconditions: A track is fully downloaded; device is in airplane mode / no network.

steps.action: With no network, open and play the downloaded track.
steps.expected: Playback starts from the local file immediately without any network request.

81.title: Transcript is available offline
81.preconditions: A downloaded track (transcript was prefetched); no network.

steps.action: Open the transcript of the downloaded track while offline.
steps.expected: The transcript loads from the local prefetch and synchronizes to playback.

82.title: Send a question and receive a streamed answer
82.preconditions: On the Chat screen; within quota; chat service available.

steps.action: Type a question and tap send.
steps.expected: The user message appears on the right, an assistant bubble appears, a 'Thinking…' status pill shows, the input clears, and the view scrolls to the bottom.

steps.action: Wait for the answer to stream.
steps.expected: Answer text streams in and renders with markdown; the status pill stays visible through the whole turn.

steps.action: Send a question whose answer fails (5xx / chat_unavailable) or is truncated at the turns limit.
steps.expected: The assistant bubble shows an error/truncated notice with a Retry action; tapping Retry re-sends the same question. (A mid-stream socket drop is auto-resumed instead and shows no Retry.)

steps.action: Scroll to the end of a completed answer and tap a suggestion chip.
steps.expected: The suggestion fills the input (editable) and can be sent as a new turn.

85.title: Show-verse question renders a verse card
85.description: Verifies the WIDGET, not the answer prose: a find/show-verse question's mocked SSE (a verse `action` body + inline `[verse:…]` marker) must render a verse card carrying the scripture address. Offline — stream is mocked.
85.preconditions: Chat reachable offline (mocked auth + mocked SSE). The stream ships a BG 2.13 verse body and a prose delta referencing it.

steps.action: Ask "BG 2.13" in chat.
steps.expected: The answer's verse marker renders as a verse card carrying the BG 2.13 address.

86.title: Make-PDF question renders a share-PDF card
86.description: Verifies the make-a-PDF intent: a "make a PDF" question's mocked SSE (a `share_pdf` action body + `[action:share_pdf|…]` marker) must render a share-PDF card listing the lecture(s) to export. Asserts the card, not the prose.
86.preconditions: Chat reachable offline (mocked auth + mocked SSE). The stream ships a share_pdf body listing "The Eternal Soul".

steps.action: Ask "Make a PDF of this lecture" in chat.
steps.expected: The answer renders a share-PDF card listing "The Eternal Soul" to export.

87.title: Locate-story question renders a chapter list
87.description: Verifies the locate-a-story intent: a "which chapter" question's mocked SSE (a chapter `action` body + `[chapter:…]` marker) must render a chapter list. Asserts the card, not the prose.
87.preconditions: Chat reachable offline (mocked auth + mocked SSE). The stream ships a "Chapter 3: Karma-linux-client" chapter body.

steps.action: Ask "Which chapter is about karma-linux-client?" in chat.
steps.expected: The answer renders a chapter list whose items name the chapter's topics (karma / action / work).

88.title: Chat service unavailable UX
88.preconditions: Chat backend returns 5xx / out-of-credits / network drop.

steps.action: Send a question while the service is down (5xx) or out of credits.
steps.expected: An inline notice explains the service is temporarily unavailable with a Retry option; the message is not silently lost.

steps.action: Send a question and drop the network mid-request.
steps.expected: A 'message failed to send' indication with Retry appears; cached history remains readable.

89.title: Verse marker renders as a verse card
89.description: Verifies the WIDGET, not the answer prose: an assistant message carrying a verse body upgrades its inline `[verse:…]` marker into a full verse card (address + verse body), not a bare chip. Pure offline — the session is fixture-seeded.
89.preconditions: Seeded offline chat session "What is the soul?" (chat_demo_soul) whose assistant answer carries a BG 2.20 verse body in its `meta`. No network.

steps.action: Open the seeded "What is the soul?" chat session.
steps.expected: The BG 2.20 verse marker renders as a verse card showing the address and verse body (not a bare chip).

90.title: Citation marker renders as a citation card
90.description: Verifies the WIDGET, not the answer prose: an assistant message carrying a citation snippet upgrades its inline `[cite:…]` marker into a full citation card (snippet + inline player), not a bare chip. Pure offline — the session is fixture-seeded.
90.preconditions: Seeded offline chat session "What is the soul?" (chat_demo_soul) whose assistant answer carries a citation snippet in its `meta`. No network.

steps.action: Open the seeded "What is the soul?" chat session.
steps.expected: The citation marker renders as a citation card (snippet + inline player), not a bare chip.

91.title: Chapter marker renders as a chapter list
91.description: Verifies the WIDGET, not the answer prose: a chapter marker in an answer upgrades into a full chapter list (its chapter/verse rows), not a bare chip. Offline — mocked SSE.
91.preconditions: Chat reachable offline (mocked auth + mocked SSE). The stream ships a "Chapter 3: Karma-linux-client" chapter body with verse rows.

steps.action: Ask "Which chapter is about karma-linux-client?" in chat.
steps.expected: The chapter marker renders as a chapter list whose rows name the chapter's verses/topics.

92.title: Share-PDF marker renders an actionable card row
92.description: Verifies the WIDGET: the share-PDF card lists each lecture as an actionable row that triggers the native share (a no-op on web; we assert it's an enabled, tappable control — not a bare chip). Offline — mocked SSE.
92.preconditions: Chat reachable offline (mocked auth + mocked SSE). The stream ships a share_pdf body listing "On Detachment".

steps.action: Ask "Share this as a PDF" in chat.
steps.expected: The share-PDF card lists "On Detachment" as an actionable row (tap fires the native share).

93.title: Open chat history and search sessions

steps.action: Open the history sheet (top-left).
steps.expected: A list of prior sessions ordered by recency is shown, each with title, date and a snippet; a search field filters by keyword.

94.title: Open a prior session
94.preconditions: At least one prior session exists.

steps.action: Tap a session in the history list.
steps.expected: The sheet closes and the chat loads that session's full history.

95.title: Start a new session
95.preconditions: A session with messages is open.

steps.action: Tap New Session.
steps.expected: The chat clears to the empty state; the new session is created on first send and the prior session remains in history.

96.title: Delete a session and delete all

steps.action: Delete a single session from the history list.
steps.expected: That session is removed from the local list.

steps.action: Use Delete All (if available) and confirm.
steps.expected: All sessions are cleared after confirmation.

97.title: Free quota exhaustion locks the composer
97.preconditions: Free user near the daily limit.

steps.action: Send questions until the daily quota is used up.
steps.expected: A usage chip appears past the visibility threshold; on the limit, an inline notice 'daily limit reached' shows with an Upgrade to Pro CTA and the composer (textarea + send) is disabled with the reset time indicated.

98.title: Pro tier has a higher limit
98.preconditions: Signed in as a Pro user.

steps.action: Use chat near / at the quota.
steps.expected: The usage chip and lock reflect the Pro quota and, when locked, show NO "Upgrade to Pro" CTA (unlike the free tier). The exact numeric limit is server-defined and not asserted client-side.

99.title: Quota resets and unlocks the composer

steps.action: Wait until the quota reset deadline (UTC midnight) passes.
steps.expected: The composer unlocks automatically and the usage chip reflects the refreshed quota.

100.title: Rate-limit backend unavailable keeps composer usable
100.preconditions: Rate-limit checker (Redis) unreachable on the server.

steps.action: Send a question when the server cannot check quota.
steps.expected: A toast indicates the quota couldn't be checked; the composer stays usable (server admits it cannot gate) — no hard 400 lockout.

101.title: Paywall opens from its entry points

steps.action: Open the paywall from Settings>Account, a chat Upgrade CTA, and a locked Pro toggle in turn.
steps.expected: Each entry opens the subscription screen with a feature carousel (swipeable slides with pagination dots) and a footer with plans.

102.title: Plans show price and 14-day free-trial badge

steps.action: View the plan list.
steps.expected: Each plan shows name, price and billing period; an introductory free-trial plan shows a '14-day free trial' badge then the recurring price (badge visible across locales, including ru).

steps.action: Select a plan.
steps.expected: Only one plan is selected at a time (radio behavior).

103.title: Purchase flow
103.preconditions: Paywall open; a plan selected; test store account.

steps.action: Tap Subscribe.
steps.expected: The button shows a loading state and the native store purchase sheet opens.

steps.action: Confirm the purchase in the store sheet.
steps.expected: On success the screen updates to 'subscription active', Pro features unlock, and the user returns to the prior screen. Cancel leaves the paywall unchanged; a declined payment shows an error and allows retry.

104.title: Restore purchases
104.preconditions: An account with a prior purchase.

steps.action: Tap Restore.
steps.expected: Entitlements are checked; if found, the subscription is restored and the screen shows 'subscription active'; if none, a 'no active subscriptions' message is shown.

105.title: Manage subscription opens the store page

steps.action: Tap Manage on the subscription row/paywall.
steps.expected: The platform's native subscription management page opens (App Store / Google Play).

steps.action: On the paywall, tap 'Can't pay?'.
steps.expected: A pre-filled support email (with the RevenueCat App User ID) is composed; purchase/restore buttons are not offered for the region.

steps.action: Tap Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
steps.expected: Each opens the corresponding document in the browser.

108.title: Anonymous account row prompts sign-in
108.preconditions: Settings is open with an anonymous (not signed-in) account.

steps.action: Observe the account row.
steps.expected: It shows a neutral avatar and a "sign in" call-to-action, plus a "Subscribe to Pro" row.

steps.action: Tap the sign-in call-to-action.
steps.expected: On iOS a sheet offers "Sign in with Apple" / "Sign in with Google"; on Android/web it starts Google sign-in directly. (There is no "Continue as Guest" — the user is already a guest.)

109.title: Signed-in account row shows profile and manage options
109.preconditions: Settings is open while signed in.

steps.action: Observe the account row.
steps.expected: It shows the profile name/avatar and "signed in", plus the subscription row reflecting the tier.

steps.action: Tap the account row.
steps.expected: An action sheet offers "Sign Out" and "Delete Account" (and Cancel). There is no "Switch Account" option.

110.title: Delete account with and without local wipe

steps.action: Choose Delete Account.
steps.expected: A sheet offers 'delete and keep my data on this device' and 'delete and wipe all data'.

steps.action: Pick 'keep data', then (in a separate run) 'wipe all'.
steps.expected: Keep-data: server account deleted, JWT cleared, local notes/playlist/history preserved. Wipe-all: server account deleted and local data wiped, app returns to anonymous/empty state.

111.title: Pro expiry locks Pro features
111.preconditions: A Pro account whose subscription can lapse.

steps.action: Let the subscription expire / entitlement revoke and reopen the app.
steps.expected: Server tier becomes free, Pro toggles lock with paywall prompts, and chat quota downgrades to the free limit.

steps.action: Tap Sign in with Google and complete the provider flow.
steps.expected: On return, the profile (email/name/avatar) syncs, the Account row updates to signed-in, and the subscription row refreshes.

steps.action: Sign out from the account action sheet.
steps.expected: The token is cleared, the Account row reverts to anonymous, the subscription row reverts to 'Subscribe to Pro', and local chat history remains.

114.title: Token refresh keeps the session alive
114.preconditions: Signed in; access token close to expiry.

steps.action: Use an authenticated feature (e.g. chat) around token expiry.
steps.expected: The token refreshes transparently and the request succeeds without forcing re-login.

115.title: App language picker switches the UI

steps.action: Open App Language and pick another language.
steps.expected: A single-select dialog shows the supported locales; on selection the entire UI switches language immediately and the choice persists across restart.

116.title: Library languages multi-select dialog
116.preconditions: On Settings (Library section, second after Account).

steps.action: Open Library Languages.
steps.expected: A checkbox multi-select dialog opens with the available library languages and current selections checked.

steps.action: Change the selection and confirm.
steps.expected: Content re-scopes to the selected languages and the subtitle shows the comma-separated list; at least one language must remain selected (OK disabled at zero).

steps.action: Toggle each appearance option (show player progress, show player on notes, highlight current sentence, open transcript automatically).
steps.expected: Each toggle takes effect in the relevant surface and persists.

118.title: Pro appearance toggles are gated
118.preconditions: A free (not subscribed) user in Settings.

steps.expected: The toggle does not turn on; the subscription screen opens (paywall is a route push to /tabs/subscription, not a modal). As a Pro user the toggle enables normally.

steps.action: Change the chat answer language and toggle Translate Citations.
steps.expected: Chat answers generate in the chosen language; citation translation behavior follows the toggle.

120.title: Sadhana: activity tracker and daily reminder

steps.expected: The time picker appears when notifications are on; the reminder is scheduled for the chosen time.

steps.action: Tap Export Database.
steps.expected: The local DB is exported to a file and a confirmation is shown.

steps.action: Tap Import Database and select a previously exported file.
steps.expected: The local database is replaced with the imported one and the app reflects the imported data.

122.title: Debug section unlock and build info

steps.expected: A Debug section appears with Logs and Clear Cache; Build Info shows app version, build id and DB info.

steps.expected: A modal Help dialog opens over Settings with a table of contents and a close button; closing returns to Settings.

steps.action: Tap a page in the TOC, then Back.

125.title: Help content follows the app language

steps.expected: Help content is shown in the active language (en/ru), falling back to English where a page is missing.

126.title: Audio keeps playing in the background and when locked

steps.expected: On a native device the audio keeps playing (iOS background audio mode / Android foreground media service). On web, audio is expected to stop.

127.title: Lock-screen / notification media controls
127.preconditions: Playback active in the background. Run once per device.

steps.action: Use play/pause and seek from the lock screen / Control Center (iOS) or the media notification (Android).
steps.expected: Controls toggle and seek playback; the now-playing metadata (title/author) is correct.

128.title: Audio focus: interruptions and headphone unplug

steps.expected: Playback pauses/ducks and resumes appropriately after the interruption ends.

steps.action: Unplug headphones (or disconnect Bluetooth) during playback.
steps.expected: Playback pauses (becoming-noisy handling).

129.title: Offline playback uses the native file path

131.title: Notification permission prompt and daily reminder
131.preconditions: Fresh install with notifications not granted. Run once per device.

steps.expected: The OS permission prompt appears (Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS / iOS prompt).

132.title: IAP packages and restore per store

steps.action: Use Restore on a fresh device with an entitled account.
steps.expected: Subscriptions are recovered silently and Pro unlocks.

133.title: Native share sheet and file handoff

134.title: Haptic feedback on slider interactions

steps.expected: A light haptic tick fires on native devices (no haptics on web).

135.title: Keyboard fades the floating player
135.preconditions: A track is playing. Run once per device.

steps.expected: The floating player fades out before/as the keyboard appears and returns when it hides.

136.title: Deep link from a notification on cold start

137.title: Safe-area and system bars on a notched device

138.title: Outdated-protocol update link points to the right store

139.title: Tapping a similar lecture opens that lecture in the same card
139.preconditions: A lecture card (track sheet) is open for a track that has a 'Similar by topic' list.

steps.action: Verify the swapped content and interact with it.
steps.expected: All metadata matches the tapped lecture; it can be played/added like any track; tapping a further similar lecture repeats the in-place swap (no dead tap, no stacked duplicate cards).

140.title: Delete / cancel a track while it is downloading
140.preconditions: A track is in the Home playlist and is actively downloading (radial progress, row dimmed). Tip: add a large track or throttle the network so the download stays in flight long enough to act.

steps.action: Swipe the downloading row to reveal the delete action and tap delete.
steps.expected: The row is removed from the playlist (the swipe-to-delete works even though the download is in progress — it is no longer blocked).

steps.action: Verify the download stopped.
steps.expected: The in-flight transfer is cancelled and the partial file is removed (no orphaned download keeps running / occupying storage); the track no longer shows as downloading anywhere.

steps.action: Tap (not swipe) the downloading row before deleting it.
steps.expected: Tapping a still-downloading row does nothing (it does not open/stream the not-yet-downloaded file); only the swipe-to-delete acts on it.

142.title: Sorting by date (oldest first) reorders the list
142.preconditions: On the Search → Tracks list with a populated, deterministic result set (e.g. a single source pinned so the default order is stable).

steps.action: Note the current (default) order of the top track rows. Open the filters sheet, set Sort to "Date (ascending)" and apply.
steps.expected: The list re-queries and re-orders live (no full-page reload spinner).

steps.action: Compare the new order against the order captured before sorting.
steps.expected: The visible order has changed — the date-ascending order differs from the default order.

143.title: A cover that fails once on a flaky network recovers
143.preconditions: Search landing with collection / topic cover tiles. A flaky network is simulated so one cover image fails its first request(s) and then succeeds (e.g. briefly block the asset host, then restore).

steps.action: Open the Search landing while one cover's first image request fails, then let the network recover.
steps.expected: The affected cover is re-requested automatically (bounded retry) and decodes — it does not stay blank/invisible forever.

steps.action: Observe all visible covers after recovery.
steps.expected: Every visible cover, including the one that failed first, is displayed (decoded, fully visible). No permanently broken cover remains.

144.title: A failed content-DB download shows Retry and recovers
144.preconditions: A brand-new install with no cached catalog. The first content-database download is made to fail (e.g. disable connectivity right at first launch, or block the catalog host).

steps.action: Launch the app for the first time while the catalog (content-DB) download fails.
steps.expected: The Welcome screen shows an error state with a working "Retry" button — NOT an endless "Downloading…" splash that hangs forever.

steps.action: Restore connectivity and tap Retry.
steps.expected: The download succeeds on the next attempt and the app proceeds all the way to a populated Home (bottom tab bar + Up-Next rows visible). No re-bricking on the second attempt.

145.title: Launches to a populated Home
145.preconditions: A returning user with seeded local data (the Up-Next playlist already has tracks). Network available.

steps.action: Cold-launch the app.
steps.expected: It boots past the Welcome screen straight to the Home tab; the bottom tab bar is visible.

steps.action: Observe the Home content.
steps.expected: Home is populated — the Up-Next queue shows its seeded tracks (at least one row visible), not an empty state.

146.title: Swiping the floating player changes its page
146.preconditions: A track is playing and the floating mini-player is visible with its page dots.

steps.action: Swipe vertically (upward) on the floating player.
steps.expected: The player's carousel advances to the next page — the active page-dot moves to a different dot than before the swipe.

147.title: Tapping a track opens its card
147.preconditions: On a populated list of tracks (Library or Search) with at least one track row.

steps.action: Tap a track row.
steps.expected: The track card (bottom sheet) opens showing a non-empty title and the two primary actions — Add to playlist and Share.

steps.action: Tap the card's close button.
steps.expected: The card dismisses cleanly and the list is shown again.
